documentError.description:
Why no document was stored, when one was requested via DocumentURL but could not be
downloaded. The deviation itself was still registered. Null when a document was stored,
and when none was supplied.
documentError.example: Failed to download document from URL. Status code: NotFound

401.description: Api-token missing, Unauthorized client, or the calling company is not the shipper or carrier on the order
